reviews.text: Great and Small Dog care are excellent: extremely reliable, great communicators and our dog is thrilled to see them when they arrive at the door! Thanks for taking such great care of our dog.

**In response to owner’s feedback, no confusion here. My reviews are under my account/name and I’ve updated the review to include the correct name of the walker, Sam! I recall he left before I removed my dog from your service”.**

The actual walkers, particularly Lianna and Sam, were fantastic, very kind, approachable, patient and excellent with my very large breed dog. I had full confidence in them and I have nothing but positive things to say about them. For the care my dog received from the walkers, I would happily give five stars.

However, my experience with the company’s management wasn’t good.

I found some communications difficult and, at times, passive-aggressive and unfriendly. Eg when   receiving repeated duplicate emails, I raised this and the response was defensive and snarky.

The cancellation and amendment terms also proved difficult in practice. We were required to give a very long lead time to cancel or amend bookings, yet when we needed additional cover, we wouldn’t receive a response until the day we needed help or not at all. This made planning additional support impossible.

There were also occasions when our dog was collected by management because staff were unavailable. I felt that frustration was directed towards him for normal dog behaviour, such as stopping to sniff and investigate other dogs. I was particularly concerned by being told that sniffing other dogs’ bottoms and “reading their pee-mails” was inappropriate sexual behaviour. I found this advice surprising and concerning, as these are normal ways in which dogs gather information about one another and their environment.

I was also told that some of my dog’s behaviour was because he wasn’t neutered, which is wrong.

Ultimately, I decided to withdraw my dog  from the service last year when I was told that he would need to be neutered in order to continue. I had made a considered decision not to neuter him at that stage given his size and veterinary advice.

Having read the other reviews it’s clear that the owners are capable of developing positive relationships with customers they choose to engage with in that way. Unfortunately, I did not feel that I received the same treatment.

Over time, I was left with the distinct impression that they simply did not like dealing with me.

This was particularly disappointing because I had been a customer and had developed a positive relationship with the walkers who cared for my dog and who, again, were excellent.
My dog took to this place straight away. The staff made the transition easy and kept me updated in the early days. It’s been a very positive experience overall.

My 1 year old puppy has now been attending Great and Small Dog care for 3 months now and I highly recommend them. They take excellent care of my puppy, send great updates throughout the day with responsive communication and are very flexible with scheduling. Also they will happily feed my puppy when they drop him off home if I am late from work which is so great and a relief for me. So glad I found them for my puppy as he loves going there!

Alfie has been coming here for around 6 months now and absolutely loves it! He gets out for lots of walks, is safe, has lots of interaction with the other dogs which is super important for him. They also send pictures of what he’s up to during the day. He is always happy to go with them & comes home happy & tired! I feel confident that he is well looked after and very happy there. I highly recommend Great & Small Dog Care & I am so happy I found them!
Our mini wire haired dachshund has been going to Great and Small since he was 6 months old. He loves it. They are so good with him. I know he is safe with them. And He has great fun!

I use this day care for my puppy on days that I work in London (we live in Kent). This is an excellent day care that I would be happy to recommend to others with young dogs! I feel that my puppy is well looked after, in a safe and fun environment. I also feel that my puppy has become a very social dog because of the days he has spent at this day care, even if he attends infrequently. The staff are very caring, and it is lovely to receive the updates and photos throughout the day.

We love Great and Small Dog Care so much! We started taking our Jack Russell / Daschund cross, Flower, at the start of this year and it has been a huge success. Flower has become much more sociable and we can tell that she looks forward to going each week. They look after her so well there, sending updates throughout the day and taking her on a nice walk. She is always exhausted when she gets home!
Excellent service, friendly and reliable staff. Luna loves her daily walks!

They are simple brilliant. The best daycare we have sent our dogs to in nearly 10 years owning dogs in London. We have been sending our dachshund here for nearly 2 years. They are amazing. Our previous daycare (buddies/bruce) they used to spend 1.5 hours each way in the van, now he has 9-5pm of fun, love, company and stimulation. We get regular updates throughout the day about our dog, who he is hanging out with and what he has got up to. The pictures are just so cute! They celebrate the pups birthdays and always send treats back for valentines Easter Christmas etc.

You can tell they really care and know the pups. I always find my dog being cuddled when being picked up (he is a love bug and loves cuddles!) They take security seriously and put dogs welfare first. Thoroughly recommend to anyone in Kings Cross, Islington, Camden or nearby!

Our miniature Irish Doodle went to G&S dog daycare from when we moved to the area over 3 years ago to this month when we sadly are leaving the area.  The staff was always incredibly communicative and kind to our miniature irish doodle and we could not recommend them enough for daycare.

My little Welsh Terrier, Rosie, has been going to G&S since she was a puppy and absolutely loves the team there. G&S are very good at matching up Rosie with similar sized dogs and send me regular photos and updates. Rosie is always so excited and doesn’t look back when she is picked up! It’s one of the highlights of her week. I’m super grateful to the team for their excellent care of Rose, thank you so much!
A nice group of people taking care of dogs, pick-up and drop-off from nearby is very helpful. It has been a positive improvement to our dog's behaviour.

My mini dachshund has been going to Great and Small Dog Care for almost six months, since he was 3 months old, and absolutely loves it.  They take great care of our pup and are very easy and kind to deal with.  Highly recommend!

We take our 6 month puppy here once a week and he loves it. We get regular updates of our puppy and his new friends and the owners/staff are really friendly and inviting. They also do checks to make sure the dogs are fully vaccinated etc make sure all the dogs in their care are friendly. Our puppy is very tired when he gets home after a full day of socialising with all the other wonderful dogs in Great and Small Dog Care. Very happy and would definitely recommend ☺️

Molly has been going to Great and Small Dog Care for almost 4 years. She is always happy and excited when picked up and enjoys her time with the other dogs. We’ve found the service reliable and trustworthy, with genuine dog lovers.

My standard dachshund has been going for over a year. She leaps from her bed whenever they show up for pickup. She is always excited to spend a day with other dogs and comes home happy and exhausted. The staff is responsive and helpful via email. Scheduling on their app is easy. I love getting the updates from the team on chime showing my dog playing with her friends. They are kind, helpful, and professional. Their services have been a real life saver.

I can't recommend Great and Small Dog Care highly enough. My dog was very happy and well cared for attending daycare on a weekly basis for over a year. Never an issue and always responsive to any questions or concerns I had. Obviously the priority was for my dog to be happy and cared for but also as a single busy professional the peace of mind knowing that he was ok whilst I was at the office made my life that much easier. I am no longer living in London which is the only reason he no longer attends....although I did ask if they would collect him from my place of work so he could continue with them but unfortunately (yet understandably) we are now outside the catchment area :)

BEWARE.

I am writing this here to save others the pain that I, and my partner, have endured at the hands of this organisation.
We looked to move our dog from a previous daycare to a closer one for work-reasons and found Great and Small Dog Care through Google.

There were nothing but issues from the start. Our dog would often come home with the wrong lead, missing bag and once injured from 'walks' with other dogs. We also kept in contact with the company hoping issues would be rectified as we spent more time getting to know the staff. This is where the issue lies. The staff turnover is high and the dependence on individual contractors means different people looking after the dogs each day.

The dogs do not seem to be in safe hands.
Case in point, our dog was dropped off at our apartment most recently and not securely placed in his crate as requested in the notes. The excuse given was the member of staff was an individual contractor and had not read the notes. Our dog unfortunately got out and damaged property (shoes and upholstery) as well as spreading mud over the apartment. We were left astonished at the lack of communication around this and attempted to call the dog-care centre to discuss how best to move forward. We were met with what one can only describe as severe aggression and apathy. I feel compelled to warn others about this dishonesty and sheer unkindness of this business and for reference have added photos to this review showing in blue our message to the dog-care and, in white, their response.

We are in utter disbelief that any human, let alone business, would find it acceptable to speak to another in such a manner. They have threatened in their reply with anger in place of looking to resolve any issue we had. They do not answer telephone calls as is stated in their e-mail below, and they will certainly not look to rectify any issues that arise. BEWARE. Stay safe and avoid this business at all costs.

I am more than happy to be contacted by anyone who might also have experienced issues with this daycare (as it seems this is not a sole incident with us) or anyone thinking about placing their dog in the care of this company. We have luckily saved all our correspondence and photos of the incidents raised with the organisation and would be happy to share.
